name: TODAY feedback OFF (control)
description: Control arm for today_feedback_on.json. Identical in every setting except feedback=false and the results folder.
notes: Run this immediately after today_feedback_on.json, changing nothing else.
The gate (45 articles / 180 days) MUST stay identical to the ON arm. If the
corpus changes between the two arms — another backfill, a re-screen — the cells
that pass could differ, and the pairing silently breaks. Finish both arms before
Output lands in results/portfolio_sim/feedback_off/ and every filename is tagged
'_fboff', so the arms stay distinguishable even outside their folders.
Then: python analyze_feedback.py   (paired by window: ROI + Sharpe, sign test,
Wilcoxon, behavioral deltas, and the retained-vs-dropped winner-chasing test)
